tests.name: after a failed admission a relaunched child holds the drain, but reads interrupted: that session reads error, which the roster takes for dead
tests.contractSource: GUI design §§3.1,4.1/4.5; documented failed-admission transport doubt and background liveness exception
tests.detectableRegression: Admission failure closes its launched child; a confirmed surviving child still blocks the drain while the transport-doubt fold reads interrupted.
tests.independentOracle: Fixed stopped task outcome, renewed launch identity, liveness="working", session status="error" and roster status="interrupted".
tests.stableSeam: OpenCodeThreadSession public operations/status/events with raw SSE frames and recorded HTTP provider requests; nextStream and turn.completed receipts only drive virtual time.
tests.refactorResistance: Native timers run the unchanged production util.delay. No delay injection, private callback count, exact backoff duration, implementation constant, or internal identifier is asserted; boundary-preserving refactors preserve the oracles.
tests.uniqueProtection: Owns admission failure followed by child survival, which pure task normalization and ordinary successful-turn child tests do not exercise.
tests.validation: Passed full session.test.ts (111 cases) and two focused runs including this case (10 cases each).

tests.name: a Stop whose abort request failed: the stream's or the server's word that the run ended settles the turn as the abort would have — two idle frames or a lone one, before the failure or after it, or a reconnect's status poll; without that word, the next Stop asks the server again — and the next run is a new one
tests.contractSource: OpenCode fixture observations 5–7,11,29; GUI turn/interrupt ownership contract
tests.detectableRegression: A failed abort may be confirmed by live idle or reconnect status; late abort echoes must not terminate the next independent run.
tests.independentOracle: Exactly the stopped turn gets turn.aborted once, no turn.completed for that stopped turn, ready session, and a subsequent woken/host turn retains its own expected identity/state.
tests.stableSeam: OpenCodeThreadSession public operations/status/events with raw SSE frames and recorded HTTP provider requests; nextStream and turn.completed receipts only drive virtual time.
tests.refactorResistance: Native timers run the unchanged production util.delay. No delay injection, private callback count, exact backoff duration, implementation constant, or internal identifier is asserted; boundary-preserving refactors preserve the oracles.
tests.uniqueProtection: Owns failed-abort confirmation across supported idle spellings and reconnect, plus separation from the following run. Successful Stop tests cannot detect these failed-abort state races.
tests.validation: Passed full session.test.ts (111 cases) and two focused runs including this case (10 cases each).

tests.name: the end of a Stop whose abort request failed closes the children, then aborts them: a child's report in between asks the server only once that abort is over, so a child it ends is never relaunched — the run's idle or a reconnect's status poll
tests.contractSource: OpenCode fixture observation 29; background child/Stop ordering and liveness contracts
tests.detectableRegression: A report received while the failed Stop’s eventual end aborts a child must wait for that abort and must not revive the now-dead child.
tests.independentOracle: A single stopped child, no status read while its abort is held, no relaunch or duplicate closing row after it completes, and liveness=null.
tests.stableSeam: OpenCodeThreadSession public operations/status/events with raw SSE frames and recorded HTTP provider requests; nextStream and turn.completed receipts only drive virtual time.
tests.refactorResistance: Native timers run the unchanged production util.delay. No delay injection, private callback count, exact backoff duration, implementation constant, or internal identifier is asserted; boundary-preserving refactors preserve the oracles.
tests.uniqueProtection: Owns deferred child judging during the abort triggered by eventual failed-Stop completion, including status recovered on reconnect. Ordinary interruption and native rule tests cannot establish that ordering.
tests.validation: Passed full session.test.ts (111 cases) and two focused runs including this case (10 cases each).
